ko.title: OpenAI와 앤스로픽은 무결과였지만, curl에서 발견된 6개의 CVE 취약점
ko.hook: AI 보안 감사 시스템을 통과한 후에도 핵심 오픈소스 라이브러리인 curl에서 다수의 취약점이 발견된 사건을 분석합니다.

en.title: Six curl CVEs After OpenAI and Anthropic Came Back with Zero
en.hook: Analyzing how six critical curl vulnerabilities slipped through AI-driven security assessments.
key_takeaways: Uncovers six curl CVEs missed by recent OpenAI and Anthropic security audits
Highlights the critical challenges in software supply chain security
Demonstrates the current limitations of AI-powered code vulnerability detection
